uniform_prime_choice_obstruction.claim: For every prime p>13 and every extension degree m>=1, these five base-field locators are distinct and give the same ternary collision under symbol sum and two moments. Prime selection alone cannot make the whole field a distance6 locator set for this checksum scheme.
uniform_prime_choice_obstruction.proof: The first three weighted integer moments vanish exactly; pairwise differences have prime factors only2,3,5,11,13. Division by11 gives the displayed normalized rational family point. These identities survive reduction and base-field inclusion.
uniform_prime_choice_obstruction.third_check: Its only prime factors are2,3,7, so the third moment excludes this collision for every p>13.
uniform_prime_choice_obstruction.scope: Whole-field two-moment shortcut only; not a lower bound for restricted locator sets or all nonlinear codes. Known source obstruction mechanism, no new-paper claim.
